Ace Cleaner – Junk Cleaner & File Manager
Managing your device storage doesn’t have to be complicated. Ace Cleaner offers a simple to clean junk files, organize apps, and manage your photos, videos, and documents.

●Clean Junk Files & Cache
Over time, phones accumulate temporary files, cache data, and other items that may take up unnecessary storage. Ace Cleaner scans junk files and allows you to review and remove them.

●App Organizer
With Ace Cleaner’s App Organizer, you can:
View all installed apps
Check storage and data usage for each app
Uninstall apps you no longer need

●Photo & Video Tidy-Up
Screenshots, duplicate images, and old videos can slowly fill your gallery. Ace Cleaner helps you:
Review photos, videos, and documents with ease
Decide what to keep or remove

●Large File Finder
 Ace Cleaner makes it easy to:
Identify the biggest files on your device
Choose whether to keep or delete them

🔒 On-Device Privacy Protection
All scanning, cleaning, and file management happen locally on your device. None of your personal files are uploaded, collected, or shared. 

✨ Designed for Simplicity & Control
Intuitive interface for everyday file management
Combines junk cleaning, app organization, and file management in one tool
Clear choices and transparent actions

Clean junk files, organize apps, tidy up photos, videos, and documents, and locate large files — all within a single app designed to keep you in control and protect your privacy.

Privacy Policy: https://cleanacepl.com/privacy
